fib: ______ is the process and the policy of reducing the amount of waste produced by a person or a society.
Waste minimisation
Waste minimisation is the process and the policy of reducing the amount of waste produced by a person or a society.
______ refers to materials generated as a result of patient diagnosis, treatment, or immunisation of human beings or animals.
Medical waste
Medical waste refers to materials generated as a result of patient diagnosis, treatment, or immunisation of human beings or animals.
______ can be defined as "systematically reducing waste at source".
Biomedical waste minimisation
Biomedical waste minimisation can be defined as "systematically reducing waste at source".
______ are used to create raw materials.
recyclables
recyclables are used to create raw materials.
______ is a reduction process and the final product is subjected to some minor oxidations when applied to land.
anaerobic process
An anaerobic process is a reduction process and the final product is subjected to some minor oxidations when applied to land.
______ refers to the collection and reuse of waste materials such as empty beverage containers.
Recycling
Recycling refers to the collection and reuse of waste materials such as empty beverage containers.
______ is the collection, transport, processing, recycling or disposal, managing and monitoring of waste materials.
Waste management
Waste management is the collection, transport, processing, recycling or disposal, managing and monitoring of waste materials.
______ is the process of destroying waste materials by burning it within the temperature range of 9000℃ - 12000℃.
Incineration
Incineration is the process of destroying waste materials by burning it within the temperature range of 9000℃ - 12000℃.
______ is used for many things-depending on what grade they were recycled from.
Glass
Glass is used for many things- depending on what grade they were recycled from.
